usedFor: humanitix holds events, orders and attendees, and Google Drive copies a file into a folder through “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event Is Created” in humanitix, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new event gets its own copy of a planning file, named as you choose.

watchOut: “New Event Is Created” in humanitix is polling, so the copy appears after a scheduled check.
